name: vinyl-scout
description: Personal vinyl cataloging agent — single-user, Netlify-hosted.

scripts.check: for f in netlify/functions/*.mjs netlify/lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:audio-preview && npm run test:artists-playing && npm run test:concert-radar-e2e && npm run test:wishlist && npm run test:jambase-shows && npm run test:catalog-cache && npm run test:netlify-ignore && npm run test:concert-radar-health-check && node scripts/check-content-drift.mjs
